fields.description:
## Summary

Source is mandatory going forward (Aug 25 sync), but the field is optional and blank on all existing Deals, so nothing today forces a user to set it and the suffix logic (BUILD-247/248) silently no-ops.

**Solution: make Source required on the Deal record page via Dynamic Forms so it can't be skipped at creation, confirm field placement, and add a Source column to the Deal list view. Forward-looking only — no validation rule, no backfill.** Coordinate with BUILD-119/120/121 (list view + layout rebuilds).

## Current state

Deal\__c.Source_\_c optional; not confirmed on the Deal record page; blank on all existing Deals. No enforcement anywhere.

## Proposed solution

1. Add Source__c to the Deal record page (Deal Details section, near Partner/Operator) if not already present — via Dynamic Forms, per the Aug 17 org convention (Dynamic Lightning pages over classic layouts).
2. Mark the Source field component required in Dynamic Forms — not field-level required, no validation rule — so UI creation demands it while API/flow/data-load paths stay unblocked. Verify the New Deal path honors it: if the New modal still renders the classic layout, mark Source required there too.
3. Add Source as a column on the primary Deal list view(s) (Aug 25 ask — Joyce).

## Acceptance criteria

1. New Deal created via the UI cannot be saved without Source.
2. API / data loads / flows can still create or update Deals without Source (deliberately not enforced there).
3. Existing Deals are untouched: no backfill, names and External Deal IDs unchanged.
4. Deal list view shows Source column.

## Out of scope

* Validation rule (explicitly rejected — deal updates must not be blocked).
* Backfill of existing Deals (may be revisited later; if done, names restamp automatically via BUILD-248's flow).
